items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I listened to them records -- they had them all around the jukeboxes around here. See, I came home in '43 and stayed down here. I didn't go back up there any more...

ctx.x: You mean trying to give him stuff he couldn't read?

Yeah, I think he did. I didn't recognize it, but he didn't make himself known on that until later years. He came down here with Basie. He wasn't in Basie's band, but he was added...him and Dizzy Gillespie was added attraction to Basie's
